forum.title: No Fix and no PPS with TESEO-LIV4F
forum.best_answer_content:
PPS won't start until the LIV4F has a fix.

The RF\_IN has a DC bias to drive the antenna. Same as the VCC\_RF pin. As a first step, I recommend checking the voltage at the antenna connector to make sure it is 3.3V.

The if there is voltage, try the following:

* Remove the ESD (CR1).

+ Try this first and see if you can get a signal. Make sure the antenna is outside for the first test.

* Remove C36 & L12 and short C34 & L11.

+ This will simplify the RF input path

+ The RF\_IN pin provides DC for the antenna (same as VCC\_RF) up to 35mA current draw. The antenna only draws 4mA, so this should be fine.

+ The LIV4F has a coupling cap and inductor internal to the module.

If this works, then the antenna power LDO circuit needs to be examined.
forum.content_text:
Hello,

I recently made a custom PCB with the teseo-liv4ftr for an avionic and i have trouble making it work. The module responds to the nmea commands via I2C, but I couldn't get a fix whatsoever and not even a signal on the PPS pin.

The Teseo is soldered correctly and with a proper LDO power supply. Also, I am using a Taoglas active antenna (AP.25M.07.0080A).

Can anybody please help me?
